name: CI hook-failure burst — 3+ self-hosted jobs of one run failed within 60 s of starting (presumed ARC hook failure)
description: Fires when, in the trailing 10 min, at least 3 jobs of ONE workflow run (breakdown ci.run_id) on the self-hosted pool (ci.runner.kind=self-hosted) concluded failure with duration_ms < 60000. Heuristic, PRESUMED by shape: github-ci carries no step name or error text; a job failing at the ARC container hook (e.g. 'connect ECONNREFUSED 10.43.0.1:443' then 'Executing the custom container implementation failed', as 17 jobs did in the 2026-09-06 06:07Z k3s restart) ends within a minute; a genuinely fast-failing check can match too, hence one job does not fire. Runbook: open the run; if the failed jobs show the hook error, read the node: `journalctl -u k3s --since -30min` for a restart or panic, `systemctl show k3s -p ExecMainStartTimestamp`, the lifecycle sweep's api-unavailable class (journalctl -u scan-runner-pod-lifecycle); clear stale-owner Terminating PVCs if pods sit Pending after a restart (livespec-n5eudb). Emitter: each repo's ci.yml export-telemetry job -> github-ci. Work item: livespec-kgdlte.
